entries.summary: Added Claude Opus 5 (claude-opus-5), now the default Opus model
Introducing Claude Sonnet 5: now the default model in Claude Code, native 1M context
MCP tool calls running longer than 2 minutes now move to the background automatically
entries.note: Our approval cards are MCP tool calls and block on the user; threshold raised at spawn time. Whether the CLI measures wall-clock or idle time was not verified empirically.

entries.summary: Added mcp_server_errors to the headless stream-json init event
Fixed MCP servers ignoring a per-server request_timeout_ms
entries.note: Turned out to be a data-loss bug on our side: every unmodeled key was dropped when rewriting .mcp.json.

entries.summary: Changed session transcripts to record the reasoning effort level on each assistant message
Added --forward-subagent-text to include subagent text and thinking in stream-json output
Added nested subagent forwarding in stream-json (depth 2+), keyed by spawning Agent tool_use id
Changed headless/SDK sessions to apply a set_model control request mid-turn
Changed the "default" permission mode to "Manual" across the CLI; manual accepted alongside default
entries.note: ChatPermissionMode.normal still sends `default`, which the CLI keeps accepting. Renaming our own label to "Manual" is cosmetic; revisit only if the CLI drops `default`.
